# Test fixtures

- `r_reference.json`, `r_camis.json`: generated by `validation/generate_r_reference.R` (R 4.3.3, vcdExtra 0.8.5, coin 1.4.3, epiR 2.0.67). Regenerate with `Rscript validation/generate_r_reference.R` from the repository root.
- `adcibc.csv`: ADCIBC from the CDISC pilot study (CDISCPILOT01), as used by PHUSE CAMIS (`data/adcibc.csv` in github.com/PSIAIMS/CAMIS). The data originate from the PHUSE Test Data Factory.
